title: Pairing Matters: Performance, Failures, and Efficiency in Lightweight Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-hosting coding agents is often necessary for software-engineering teams that must keep proprietary code and development traces within controlled infrastructure. Lightweight, open-weight models make such deployment more feasible by reducing hardware requirements, while strong results on repository-level benchmarks demonstrate their potential for demanding coding tasks. Deploying these models as coding agents requires pairing them with an agent harness, making their joint performance a key deployment consideration. Yet existing leaderboards primarily report fixed harness-model configurations rather than controlled comparisons across alternative pairings. To address this gap, we investigate harness-model interactions through a controlled full-factorial evaluation of six open-source harnesses and three lightweight coding models across 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, producing 1,800 graded runs under common serving, metering, and grading c

translated_title: 配对至关重要：轻量级编码代理的性能、失败与效率
translated_abstract: 对于需要将专有代码和开发轨迹保留在受控基础设施中的软件工程团队而言，自主托管编码代理往往是必要的。轻量级、开放权重的模型通过降低硬件要求使这种部署更加可行，同时它们在仓库级基准测试上的强劲表现也证明了其在高难度编码任务中的潜力。将这些模型部署为编码代理需要将其与代理框架进行配对，这使得二者的联合性能成为关键的部署考量因素。然而，现有的排行榜主要报告固定的框架-模型配置，而非对各种替代配对进行受控比较。为填补这一空白，我们通过对六个开源框架和三个轻量级编码模型在100个SWE-bench Verified任务上进行受控全因子评估来研究框架与模型之间的交互作用，在统一的服务、计量和评分条件下产生了1,800次评级运行。
tldr: 本研究通过对六个开源代理框架与三个轻量级编码模型在SWE-bench Verified任务上进行1,800次运行的全因子受控评估，首次系统揭示了框架-模型配对方式对编码代理性能、失败模式和效率的显著影响。
